text_en: In the one hundred forty-ninth year word came to Judas and his men that Antiochus Eupator was coming with a great army against Judea,
text_cn: 一四九年，犹大和他的部下听说安提约古欧帕托尔率领大军来进攻犹太，

text_en: and with him Lysias, his guardian, who had charge of the government. Each of them had a Greek force of one hundred ten thousand infantry, five thousand three hundred cavalry, twenty-two elephants, and three hundred chariots armed with scythes.
text_cn: 他的监护人里息雅总理也与他同来；各自率领着希腊兵，共计步兵十一万，骑兵五千三百，象二十二头，镰刀车三百辆。

text_en: Menelaus also joined them and with utter hypocrisy urged Antiochus on, not for the sake of his country’s welfare, but because he thought that he would be established in office.
text_cn: 默乃劳也混入其中，假仁假义地激励安提约古；他如此作，并非为了国家的安全，而只是想巩固自己的职位。

text_en: But the King of kings aroused the anger of Antiochus against the scoundrel; and when Lysias informed him that this man was to blame for all the trouble, he ordered them to take him to Beroea and to put him to death by the method that is customary in that place.
text_cn: 但万王之王激动安提约古恼恨这个恶徒；里息雅向君王证明此人是万恶的罪魁，安提约古即下令解送他到贝洛雅去，按当地的刑法处死他。

text_en: For there is a tower there, fifty cubits high, full of ashes, and it has a rim running around it that on all sides inclines precipitously into the ashes.
text_cn: 在那里有一座塔，高五十余肘，里面满是火灰，设有一架旋机，能从各方面把人投入火灰中。

text_en: There they all push to destruction anyone guilty of sacrilege or notorious for other crimes.
text_cn: 凡盗窃庙物，或犯其他重罪的人，都应投入里面处死。

text_en: By such a fate it came about that Menelaus the lawbreaker died, without even burial in the earth.
text_cn: 这犯法的默乃劳就是受这刑罚而死的，死后也不得入土。

text_en: And this was eminently just; because he had committed many sins against the altar whose fire and ashes were holy, he met his death in ashes.
text_cn: 祭坛上的火和灰原是圣洁的：他既多次亵渎祭坛，如今死在火灰中，是极公平的。

text_en: The king with barbarous arrogance was coming to show the Jews things far worse than those that had been done in his father’s time.
text_cn: 此时，国王起了一种野蛮和强横的念头，想加害犹太人，比他父亲所行的还要残酷。

text_en: But when Judas heard of this, he ordered the people to call upon the Lord day and night, now if ever to help those who were on the point of being deprived of the law and their country and the holy temple,
text_cn: 犹大一知道这事，便命民众日夜呼求上主，求他这次还如从前一样，拯救他们，不使法律、国家和圣殿遭受浩劫，

text_en: and not to let the people who had just begun to revive fall into the hands of the blasphemous Gentiles.
text_cn: 不让这刚才复兴的民族落在渎神的异民手中。

text_en: When they had all joined in the same petition and had implored the merciful Lord with weeping and fasting and lying prostrate for three days without ceasing, Judas exhorted them and ordered them to stand ready.
text_cn: 众人一致顺命，一连三天俯伏在地，哀哭禁食，恳求仁慈的上主。于是犹大勉励众人后，下令备战，

text_en: After consulting privately with the elders, he determined to march out and decide the matter by the help of God before the king’s army could enter Judea and get possession of the city.
text_cn: 先与长老们私下商议，然后决定在国王的军队尚未开入犹太和占领京城以前，就出发迎击，赖天主的助佑来决定一切。

text_en: So, committing the decision to the Creator of the world and exhorting his troops to fight bravely to the death for the laws, temple, city, country, and commonwealth, he pitched his camp near Modein.
text_cn: 将战争的胜负全托付于宇宙的创造者；又劝勉自己的部下，应同他一起为法律、圣殿、京城、祖国及民权奋勇作战，死而后已。于是他就在摩丁附近扎了营。

text_en: He gave his troops the watchword, “God’s victory, ” and with a picked force of the bravest young men, he attacked the king’s pavilion at night and killed as many as two thousand men in the camp. He stabbed the leading elephant and its rider.
text_cn: 他给军队规定以“天主胜利”为口号，然后选拔一队骁勇的少年士兵，夜袭国王营幕，在营内杀了二千守兵，刺杀了象队中的领队大象，以及木楼里驭象的人。

text_en: In the end they filled the camp with terror and confusion and withdrew in triumph.
text_cn: 最后使全营敌人惊慌失措，遂凯旋而归。

text_en: This happened, just as day was dawning, because the Lord’s help protected him.
text_cn: 因了上主保护犹大，战事完了，天才破晓。

text_en: The king, having had a taste of the daring of the Jews, tried strategy in attacking their positions.
text_cn: 国王虽经验到犹太人的英勇，但仍设法侵略他们的地方。

text_en: He advanced against Beth-zur, a strong fortress of the Jews, was turned back, attacked again, and was defeated.
text_cn: 于是进攻犹太人坚固的堡垒贝特族尔，但被击退；再次进攻，又遭挫败。

text_en: Judas sent in to the garrison whatever was necessary.
text_cn: 犹大输送一切必需品，接济被围困的人，

text_en: But Rhodocus, a man from the ranks of the Jews, gave secret information to the enemy; he was sought for, caught, and put in prison.
text_cn: 但有个犹太军人，名叫洛多苛的，向敌人告密；这人被查出后，即被捕入狱。

text_en: The king negotiated a second time with the people in Beth-zur, gave pledges, received theirs, withdrew, attacked Judas and his men, was defeated;
text_cn: 国王二次与贝特族尔居民握手议和，遂离开了那里，去攻击犹大的军队，可是又遭到惨败。

text_en: he got word that Philip, who had been left in charge of the government, had revolted in Antioch; he was dismayed, called in the Jews, yielded and swore to observe all their rights, settled with them and offered sacrifice, honored the sanctuary and showed generosity to the holy place.
text_cn: 那时王听说，他留在安提约基雅摄政的斐理伯造反，就心慌意乱，遂与犹太人讲和，宣誓接受他们一切合理的条件；讲和后，他也献了祭，对圣殿起敬畏，对圣所也表示慷慨大方。

text_en: He received Maccabeus, left Hegemonides as governor from Ptolemais to Gerar,
text_cn: 王又善待了玛加伯，留下赫革摩尼德为总督，管理由仆托肋买至革勒尼人所居住的地方。

text_en: and went to Ptolemais. The people of Ptolemais were indignant over the treaty; in fact they were so angry that they wanted to annul its terms.
text_cn: 王回到仆托肋买，那里的居民却愤愤不平，不满意这些和约，要废除所议定的事项。

text_en: Lysias took the public platform, made the best possible defense, convinced them, appeased them, gained their goodwill, and set out for Antioch. This is how the king’s attack and withdrawal turned out.
text_cn: 里息雅便登台竭力辩解，说服了他们，赢得了他们的信心，使他们宁静下来，然后回安提约基雅去了。这就是王进军及撤兵的事。
